metadata.description: Shared decision memory for AI dev teams — decisions, the why, and the dead ends, captured automatically.

plugins.name: kgai
plugins.description: Shared decision memory for AI dev teams — your AI records the why behind the code, recalls it before changes, and syncs it without merge conflicts.

plugins.name: kgai-mod
plugins.description: Experimental, opt-in. Requires Claude Code with function hooks (Claude Code Mods) and the kgai plugin. Runs the end-of-turn decision capture on the side, so the transcript stays clean unless a decision is actually recorded.
